body:
In term of API naming for the multi indices feature what we have today on react-is: 

* connectAutocomplete: a connector that have the query (and can refine on it) and all the hits. 
* index: to specify stuff related to one index in particular (could be any widgets here, of search parameters). 

The way we use it:

* Autocomplete use case => usage of connectAutoComplete
* Displaying hits from different indices => usage of Index. 

Hope that helps to make a naming choice. I'd love to have similar connectors whenever possible.
